messages.subject: Interpret warning message and generating older version of profile charts?
messages.subject_clean: Interpret warning message and generating older version of profile charts?
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

I have been using tidyLPA package for my master thesis data analysis and so far enjoying the easy-to-use latent profile analysis made possible by this package. I've had a small problem running some of my models: I received error message from the output suggesting that "One or more analyses resulted in warnings! Examine these analyses carefully" on one of my models and I was not quite sure what specific problem with that model that tidyLPA was suggesting. Would it be possible for anybody to tell me a bit more about how to interpret this error message? Also, I was wondering whether it is still possible to generate the older version of profile plots before the 1.0.0 update? I am currently on tidyLPA 1.0.4 with R 3.6.1 .

Thank you all for suggestions!

Best,
Tianfang
